description: This file contains PHP functions related to the SuiteCRM portal, handling functionalities such as retrieving bugs, cases, notes, related modules, and user login/authentication for the portal interface. It also manages session-based access control and related data fetching mechanisms for various modules like Contacts, Accounts, and Cases.

classes.name: SoapError
classes.description: A class used to handle SOAP error reporting, setting error messages and converting errors into SOAP-compatible arrays.

classes.name: User
classes.description: A class representing users in the system, including methods to find users by password.

methods.name: portal_validate_authenticated
methods.description: Validates whether a session is authenticated for portal access (implicitly used).

methods.name: get_return_value
methods.description: Formats the data of a module record into a SOAP response-compatible structure.

methods.name: get_field_list
methods.description: Retrieves the list of fields for a given module record, used for response formatting.

methods.name: filter_return_list
methods.description: Filters the returned list of records based on selected fields.

methods.name: filter_field_list
methods.description: Filters the list of fields to include only those requested.
